IBPS Clerk CSA 16th Correction Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the Correction Form for the post of Customer Service Associate (Clerk). This recruitment has been issued for 11,403 posts. The online application process for IBPS Clerk CSA 16th Recruitment 2026 has started on 01 August 2026, and candidates can apply till 28 August 2026 Extend. Candidates must check the complete details for IBPS Clerk CSA 16th Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 August 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 28 August 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 August 2026
  • Correction Form : 04-05 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
